in_sanskrit.name: Kaptan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, Commander
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kaptan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। From Sanskrit 'Kapata' meaning 'door' or 'gate'. Kaptan derives from the title given to a doorkeeper or gatekeeper, later evolving to mean 'commander' or 'captain'. In Hindu mythology, Kaptan is a title given to various deities and celestial beings, signifying their protective and guiding roles.
